dsDescriptionValue.value:
The ESE and RSM Open Science 2021 Spring Survey explored how researchers perceive and use open science practices. Eight main topics were covered:

  1. Preregistration
  2. Open materials/code
  3. Open data
  4. Pre-publication archiving
  5. Open access
  6. General experience with open science practices
  7. Awareness of available tools
  8. Role of ERIM

topicClassValue.value: Science, Technology And Engineering Curriculum And Pedagogy
